name: Canvas UI
summary: Open-source HTML-in-canvas WebGL/WebGPU effects over live interactive UI (shadcn registry).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 35 React WebGL builds — not full inventory; WebGPU (-webgpu) and non-React flavors not ingested.
License is MIT + Commons Clause — free personal/commercial use in apps; reselling/redistributing components as a library restricted (LICENSE.md).
html-in-canvas API is experimental (Chrome flag / origin trial); components degrade gracefully without it.
Install uses namespaced @canvas-ui registry (https://canvasui.dev/r/{name}.json) or full URL.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Particle Reveal
components.summary: Live HTML as fine particles that merge into crisp UI around the cursor.

demo.peerNotes: React 19 recommended; html-in-canvas may need Chrome flag/origin trial — graceful HTML fallback elsewhere

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @canvas-ui/particle-reveal-react
# or: npx shadcn@latest add https://canvasui.dev/r/particle-reveal-react.json

import { ParticleReveal } from "@/components/canvasui/ParticleReveal";

<ParticleReveal>
  <YourContent />
</ParticleReveal>

copyPrompt.text: Use Canvas UI free component `Particle Reveal` (React WebGL build, registry `particle-reveal-react`) from https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/particle-reveal. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @canvas-ui/particle-reveal-react` after configuring `"registries": {"@canvas-ui": "https://canvasui.dev/r/{name}.json"}` in components.json, or `npx shadcn@latest add https://canvasui.dev/r/particle-reveal-react.json`. Registry item: https://canvasui.dev/r/particle-reveal-react.json. Import from `@/components/canvasui/ParticleReveal`. Some effects need Chrome html-in-canvas (flag/origin trial); others degrade to HTML + GPU overlay. License: MIT + Commons Clause (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidHDev/canvas-ui/main/LICENSE.md; Copyright (c) 2026 David Haz) — free in apps; no reselling components as a library. Pricing free.
